an4.104:1.8: evameva kho bhikkhave cattārome udakarahadupamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ
an4.104:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo uttāno hoti gambhīrobhāso
an4.104:2.2: idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṃghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ
an4.104:2.3: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
an4.104:2.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo uttāno hoti gambhīrobhāso
an4.104:2.5: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave udakarahado uttāno gambhīrobhāso
an4.104:3.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo gambhīro hoti uttānobhāso
